newsitem.title: USA: Giant Cement to buy Solite of Virginia.
newsitem.headline: Giant Cement to buy Solite of Virginia.

text.p: Giant Cement Holding Inc said Monday it has a letter of intent to buy Solite Corp of Richmond, Virginia.
Solite, a privately held construction materials maker and resource recovery company, had about $48 million in fiscal 1996 revenues.
Giant said it will exchange 1.3 million shares of its common stock for all Solite common shares outstanding.

Giant said the deal also includes the assumption of up to $18 million of Solite's long-term debt and additional shares of Giant stock and cash over a period of three years, if Solite operations achieve certain earnings.

If completed, the deal would include three lightweight aggregate manufacturing facilities and their resource recovery operations, five concrete block plants and a waste treatment and blending facility, Giant said.
Giant posted about $100 million in revenues for fiscal 1995.
